description: This PHP file contains a unit test class 'DataGroupServiceTest' which tests the 'DataGroupService' class and its interactions with related data access object 'DataGroupDao' and various data entity classes. It verifies methods for retrieving data group permissions, data groups, and permission collections, ensuring correct collection and aggregation of permissions per data group.

classes.name: DataGroupServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the DataGroupService functionality, permissions retrieval, and permission collection aggregation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of DataGroupService before each test.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieving permissions for a specific data group and user role.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of data groups, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single data group by identifier.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithOnlyOnePermissionForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests fetching a collection of permissions when only one permission set exists for a data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithTwoPermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests merging multiple permissions for a single data group, ensuring correct aggregation.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithMultiplePermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests merging multiple permission sets across multiple permissions for a single data group, with complex permission combinations.
